name: Free-LLM catalog
description: Free LLM API providers and their free models, checked against official sources.

providers.name: Agnes AI
providers.rate_limit: About 30 RPM per account (video 2 RPM), per third-party listings

providers.name: AI Horde (OpenAI-compatible front)
providers.rate_limit: Queue-based; anonymous requests have the lowest priority, registered users earn kudos for priority

providers.name: AIHubMix (free models)
providers.rate_limit: 5 RPM per account on most *-free routes
providers.daily_limit: 100 requests/day and 1M tokens/day per account (500 RPD on some, e.g. glm-4.7-flash-free, coding-minimax-m3-free)

providers.name: Aion Labs
providers.daily_limit: Daily free credit allowance (amount not published by Aion Labs)

providers.name: AMD Radeon Cloud (Token Factory)
providers.rate_limit: 20 RPM per account, 30 RPM per API key, 120 RPM per IP, 8 concurrent requests per key
providers.daily_limit: Daily cap in points (pts), per account; resets 00:00 UTC+8

providers.name: AnyAPI
providers.rate_limit: Limited API calls on the Free plan (exact RPM not published)
providers.daily_limit: 100K ANY tokens per day, free models only

providers.name: Arli AI
providers.rate_limit: 1 request at a time; max 12K context tokens
providers.daily_limit: Limited trial uses per model (about 5 requests per 2 days, per third-party list)

providers.name: BazaarLink
providers.rate_limit: 10 RPM (20 RPM with any credit), 2 concurrent requests
providers.daily_limit: 60 weighted units/day (120 with credit), resets 00:00 UTC

providers.name: BentoML
providers.rate_limit: Depends on the compute you deploy
providers.daily_limit: Free trial on sign-up, then pay-per-use

providers.name: Bytez
providers.credits: $1 free credits, refreshed every 4 weeks
providers.credits_duration: Credits expire 4 weeks after grant" - Qwen/Qwen3-4B | Qwen3 4B | not stated - (any open chat model o

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.rate_limit: 5 RPM, 30K uncached / 90K total TPM, 1M tokens per hour and per day (Free Trial)
providers.credits: $5 after adding a verified payment method (expires after 30 days)

providers.name: Cerebrium
providers.credits: No sign-up credit shown on the pricing page (Hobby plan: free platform, compute billed per second)

providers.name: CheapLLM
providers.rate_limit: No per-key RPM/TPM cap; one request at a time per account

providers.name: Dahl Inference
providers.daily_limit: No daily cap: one-time 100M token promotion

providers.name: Experiential Labs
providers.rate_limit: 10 RPM and 250K TPM per free core model
providers.daily_limit: 1M input+output tokens/day shared across free core models, reset 00:00 UTC

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.rate_limit: 10 RPM (no payment method) / up to 6,000 RPM (with card + credits)
providers.credits: Free starter credit for new accounts (amount no longer stated by Fireworks; historically $1)

providers.name: FreeInference
providers.rate_limit: Not published ("generous quota"; HTTP 429 when rate-limited)

providers.name: FreeModel
providers.rate_limit: 30 requests/day on the free plan; effective upstream rate limits also apply

models.name: fm-v1-lite (free tier alias, default model)
models.context: Varies — alias over a pool of upstream models

providers.name: Friendli AI
providers.credits: Trial credits at onboarding (amount not published)

providers.name: Gonka Broker
providers.daily_limit: Monthly free token grant after SMS verification (does not accumulate)

providers.name: GonkaRouter
providers.credits: 1M free tokens for new users

providers.name: Google AI Studio
providers.rate_limit: Varies by model (per-model limits are now shown only inside AI Studio)
providers.daily_limit: Varies by model (shown in AI Studio). Free: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 3.x Flash / Flash-Lite and Gemma 4; Gemini 3.x Pro and the other Gemini 4 models are paid

providers.name: Google Vertex AI express mode (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)
providers.rate_limit: Gemini 2.5 models: 10 RPM; Gemini 3 models: dynamic limits
providers.credits: Free-tier quota access, no billing account
providers.credits_duration: Up to 90 days for new Google Cloud users

providers.name: Grokified
providers.rate_limit: No Grokified rate limit (429 only when the shared upstream pool is busy)
providers.daily_limit: No daily budget: one-time $5 signup credit (HTTP 402 when spent)

providers.name: Groq
providers.rate_limit: 30 RPM; 8K TPM on most chat models (varies by model)
providers.daily_limit: 1,000 requests/day and 200K tokens/day on gpt-oss / Qwen (varies by model)

providers.name: Hetzner Inference API
providers.rate_limit: 10 requests, 4M input / 100K output tokens per 60s (per API key)
providers.daily_limit: No daily cap published (free while the API is experimental); a Hetzner account with billing details is required and Hetzner may ask for a card or ID to verify it

providers.name: HPC-AI Model APIs
providers.credits: $2 free voucher on signup ($4 with an invite code, per third-party list)

providers.name: Hyperbolic
providers.credits: $1 after phone verification (Free Tier)

providers.name: iFlytek Spark Lite
providers.rate_limit: Not published on the HTTP doc

providers.name: Inception Labs
providers.rate_limit: 1,000 RPM, 1M input tokens/min, 100K output tokens/min (Free Tier)
providers.daily_limit: No daily cap: one-time 100M token grant
providers.credits: 100M tokens

providers.name: Inferaft
providers.rate_limit: Not published for the free grant; usage is drawn at the published per-token rates

providers.name: Inferbase
providers.daily_limit: $0.50 of managed model usage per day; 5,000 requests per month

providers.name: IteraCompute
providers.rate_limit: 160K tokens/minute (fair use, may queue); 128K context, 8K output
providers.daily_limit: No daily cap; 30M tokens per month until the promotion ends
providers.credits: 30M tokens/month on Qwen3.8-27B (promotion, no card)

providers.name: Jina AI (Embeddings / Reader API)
providers.rate_limit: Free key: 100 RPM, 100K TPM (embeddings); IP limit 10,000 req/60s
providers.credits: Free tokens on an auto-generated key (amount not stated on page)

providers.name: Kilo AI Gateway
providers.rate_limit: 200 requests/hour per IP on free models (anonymous use allowed)

providers.name: Kiosapi.id
providers.daily_limit: 50 requests/day per account shared across free models, reset 07:00 WIB

providers.name: LLMTR
providers.rate_limit: Not published; lower allowance in an account's first 24h
providers.daily_limit: Per-model daily allowance (e.g. 200K tokens/day on dated previews)

models.name: GLM 4.7 Flash (needs $1 top-up per third-party list)

providers.name: Merkium
providers.rate_limit: 30 requests per minute per API key, enforced as one request every 2 seconds (429 with Retry-After)

providers.name: Mixlayer
providers.rate_limit: Per-organization, per-model RPM/TPM (values shown in console only)

providers.name: Moark (Gitee AI)
providers.daily_limit: 100 free calls/day per user (free experience access token)

providers.name: ModelScope
providers.rate_limit: Concurrency limited dynamically according to platform load
providers.daily_limit: Counted in Magicubes: about 0.5, 1 or 2 per call depending on model size

providers.name: Nous Portal
providers.credits: $0 plan, but a payment method is required at sign-up (Stripe $0 checkout)

providers.name: NovAI
providers.daily_limit: Free Flash models with no daily cap published; $2 welcome credit for paid models
providers.credits: $2 welcome credit, no card

providers.name: Novita AI
providers.credits: No automatic sign-up credit; $10 per referral (both sides)

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.credits: No published credit amount: free, rate-limited trial endpoints for development

providers.name: OpenTyphoon (Typhoon API)
providers.rate_limit: 5 requests/second, 200 RPM (text models); 20 RPM for OCR

providers.name: OVH AI Endpoints
providers.rate_limit: 2 RPM per IP per model (anonymous, free); 400 RPM with a key (pay-as-you-go)

providers.name: Pollinations.ai
providers.rate_limit: API key required (anonymous access removed); no card
providers.daily_limit: Free usage paid from Quest Pollen earned in the dashboard

providers.name: Qwen (Alibaba)
providers.credits: ~1M tokens per model, 90 days (Singapore; newer models only since Oct 29, 2026)

providers.name: Regolo.ai
providers.daily_limit: 1M tokens per day during the 30-day trial
providers.credits: 30-day trial, 1M tokens/day, no card

providers.name: Replicate
providers.credits: Limited free runs on select models

providers.name: Requesty
providers.rate_limit: 20 RPM on free models (60 RPM for paying orgs)
providers.daily_limit: 200 requests/day (new orgs) / 1,000/day (paying orgs), shared across free models

providers.name: Sail Research
providers.rate_limit: Not published for Free plan (most relaxed on flex window)
providers.credits: $5 free credits every month (payment method attached)

providers.name: Sarvam AI
providers.credits: INR 100 free credits on signup
providers.credits_duration: One-time; credits do not expire (per third-party list)

providers.name: Scaleway Generative APIs
providers.credits: 1M tokens (+60 min audio transcription), all serverless models

providers.name: SEA-LION API
providers.rate_limit: 10 requests/minute per user (increase on request: sealion@aisingapore.org)

providers.name: SenseNova (SenseTime)
providers.daily_limit: Not published (\"限时放量\" during public beta)

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.rate_limit: Fixed limits on free models, shown in the console after login
providers.daily_limit: Not published on the public site

providers.name: SimpleLLM
providers.daily_limit: Free-model hourly/daily request and token allowances (values per account, not published)

providers.name: Tencent Cloud TokenHub
providers.credits: 1M free tokens per language model, once per account per model
providers.credits_duration: 90 days after claim (intl promo page; docs say 1 year); campaign ends 2026-12-31" - DeepSeek-V4-Pro

providers.name: Token Harbor
providers.rate_limit: 60 requests/min and 1,800/hour per account (100/min, 3,000/hour per IP)
providers.daily_limit: Free allowance, resets on a rolling 7-day period

providers.name: Upstage
providers.rate_limit: Per-second limits by usage tier (see upstage.ai/pricing)
providers.credits: $10 sign-up credit (announced by Upstage; not shown on the pricing page, verify)

providers.name: Vectoree
providers.daily_limit: Credit-based (empty wallet cannot call the gateway)
providers.credits: $5 welcome credit after CLI login

providers.name: Vercel AI Gateway
providers.rate_limit: Lower per-model limits than the paid tier (429 on excess)
providers.daily_limit: $5 monthly credit; Free Tier eligible models only
providers.credits: $5/month
providers.credits_duration: Monthly (stops once you buy AI Gateway credits)

providers.name: VLM Run Gateway
providers.rate_limit: Anonymous: 10/min, 30/hr per IP; with free key: 240/min, 10,000/hr
providers.credits: 100 free credits on sign-up (~$1, at $0.01/credit)

providers.name: Voyage AI (embeddings & rerankers)
providers.rate_limit: Reduced until a payment method is added (Tier 1 = 2000 RPM, 2M-16M TPM)

providers.name: Zhipu BigModel (China)
